card.name: Linking words before supportive-treatment wording
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'is', 'with' or 'provide' right after 'Treatment' or 'overdose' in overdosage sections, just before 'supportive' or 'symptomatic'. Also fires on 'and' in a journal title.
